row_scope_reconciliation.Ermatchkov: The source inventory contains 101 rows from Tables 1–3. The earlier 88-row primary pressure assessment is specifically the subset with MDEA mass fraction ≤0.49; its producer asserts 88 rows, and the Stage B design separately identifies the 13 rows above 49 wt%. Those 13 are domain-excluded from that earlier primary statistic, not unexplained missing observations. Stage B currently retains all 101 Ermatchkov rows as not-fitted comparisons.
row_scope_reconciliation.Xiao: 20 rows were previously accessed during model development and were used alongside Ermatchkov in earlier selection; they were not fitted and are excluded from Stage B selection. This earlier access must be disclosed in the final notebook.
row_scope_reconciliation.Kuranov: Stage B role inventory has 67 fitted plus 13 not-fitted rows, 80 retained rows; the inherited source-row exclusions are rows 28 and 72 from a source table with 82 points. Published Wangler Table 11 aggregates cover different published counts (64, 81, or 82 depending on model), so are not exact Stage B rowwise baselines.
